title: Spec: define node classes in spec/08-nodes.md
description: Add section to spec/08-nodes.md defining four node classes: leaf, router, relay, gateway. For each class specify: power source, RAM budget, backhaul, forward buffer size, deadline multiplier, DTN store size. Table: leaf(battery,16fwd,1x,no DTN), router(battery RPL,16fwd,1x,optional 4-msg DTN), relay(mains/solar no-backhaul,128fwd,5x,256-msg flash DTN), gateway(mains+IP,128fwd+uplink holdoff,10x,4096+ disk DTN). Explain relay rationale: backbone node, packets already consumed constrained-hop airtime. Do not define wire format or CCP encoding — those are sibling beads. Verify: markdown renders.
